capabilities: Generate tags for notes using local or cloud LLMs
Match against existing vault tags, predefined lists, or hybrid modes
Batch tag folders or the entire vault
Visualize a tag relationship network with search and force settings
Flatten hierarchical tags and choose tag naming conventions
extras: The README says it is a fork of an original plugin that is never named by name; it also contains detailed changelogs for versions 1.0.14–1.0.16 and mentions separate test documentation (TEST_INSTRUCTIONS.md, CLAUDE.md) not included in the README itself.
intentEvidence: This fork includes several enhancements over the original plugin
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to automatically analyze note content and suggest or apply tags, so manual tagging is slow and inconsistent.
summary: AI-powered tag generator that adds tags to note frontmatter via local or cloud LLMs, with batch tagging and a tag network graph.
